parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: - The delay in milliseconds before the value is updated (default is 500ms).

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: - Optional configurations for the debouncing behavior.

properties.name: leading
properties.description: Determines whether the function should be invoked on the leading edge of the timeout.

properties.name: trailing
properties.description: Determines whether the function should be invoked on the trailing edge of the timeout.

properties.name: maxWait
properties.description: The maximum time the specified function is allowed to be delayed before it is invoked.

properties.name: equalityFn
properties.description: A function to determine if the value has changed. Defaults to a function that checks if the value is strictly equal to the previous value.

returnType.name: [T, DebouncedState<(value: T) => void>]
returnType.description: An array containing the debounced value and the function to update it.
